<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/records/stats"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



With no query parameters, returns all category counts. Supplying page, size or q enables category paging: page is zero-based (default 0), size is 1..200 (default 50), and q matches a trimmed case-insensitive category-code substring. Categories are ordered by total descending then code ascending. Record totals remain global; pagination.total counts matches and pagination.totalCategories counts all labelled categories.
